title.zh: 补充缴费养老金信托修正第 2 号命令 2024
title.en: SUPPLEMENTAL CONTRIBUTORY PENSIONS TRUST AMENDMENT NO. 2 ORDER 2024

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-12-2024-SUPPLEMENTAL-CONTRIBUTORY-PENSIONS-TRUST-AMENDMENT-NO.-2-ORDER-2024.pdf》（5 页），本次切分 9 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Supplemental Contributory Pensions Trust (Amendment) (No. 2) Order, 2024 and shall be deemed to have commenced on 13th April 2015.

heading.en: of new sections 6A, 6B and 6C into S 58/2009

text.en:
The Supplemental Contributory Pensions Trust Order, 2009 is amended by the following three new sections immediately after section 6 - to examine persons 6A. (1) Without prejudice to section 6(3), an inspector or any of the referred to in section 6(2), in the course of an inspection under may examine orally any person supposed to be acquainted with the facts and circumstances of the case and shall reduce into writing any statement made by the person so examined.

(2) Such person shall be legally bound to answer the questions relating to such case put to him by such inspector or any of the referred to in section 6(2), but may refuse to answer any question the answers to which would have a tendency to expose him to a criminal or to a penalty or forfeiture.

(3) A statement made by any person under the provisions of this be read over to him and shall, after correction if necessary, be signed by him.

(4) Any person who obstructs an inspector or any of the officers in this section is guilty of an offence. to assess contributions based on information available 6B. (1) An inspector may assess any contribution which is due by any based on any information available if the employer - (a} fails to prepare and keep any register or record any pertaining to each employee as required to be performed by him under this Order or any regulations or rules made or

(b) fails or refuses to produce any contract of service, book of of salary, register and other document concerning each as required under this Order.

(2) The assessment made under subsection (1) shall be sufficient of the Board's claim for the summary recovery of any contribution section 38. of Managing Director to require information and application for search warrant 6C. (1) For the purposes of obtaining full information for ascertaining any person is liable to pay contributions under this Order, the Director may, by notice in writing, require any person(a} to furnish the Managing Director within a time specified in the notice not being less than 30 days from the date of such notice any or particulars specified in the notice;

(b) to attend personally before the Managing Director or any authorised in that behalf by the Managing Director and for examination all books, accounts, records and other which the Managing Director or authorised officer deems or

(c) to furnish the information or particulars in accordance with (a} and also to attend in accordance with paragraph (b).

(2) Where a person is found guilty of an offence under

(4)(a}, the court before which the person is found guilty shall such person to comply with the notice of the Managing .Director under

(1) within 21 days from the date of the order of the court.

(3) Whenever it appears to any court, upon written information on oath, and after any enquiry it may think necessary, that there are reasonable for suspecting that there are on particular premises any book, record or other document the production of which has been pursuant to subsection (1) and which has not been produced in with that requirement, such court may issue a warrant the Managing Director or any person named therein with or assistance - fa) to search the premises and to break open and search any drawer, chest, trunk, box, package or other receptacle, a fixture or not, in the premises; and {b) to take possession of, or secure against interference, any record or other document that appears to be the book, record or other document the production of which was so

(4) Any person who - fa) fails to comply with subsection (1); or {b) obstructs the Managing Director or any person named referred to in subsection (3), of an offence.".

The principal Order is amended by inserting the following new section after section 38 - "Joint and several liability on directors etc. 38A. (1) Where any contribution remaining unpaid by a body corporate, association or body of persons, then, notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Order or any other written law, the directors or directors of such body corporate, or the partners or former partners of such partnership, or the members of such association or body of persons or the office bearers of such association or body of persons, as the case may be, during such period in which contributions were liable to be paid, shall with the body corporate, partnership, association or body of liable to pay contributions, be jointly and severally liable for the due and payable to the Trust.

(2) In this section, "contributions" includes any dividend, service and penalty on any contribution charged by the Board under this or any regulations or rules made thereunder.". of section 39
